description: Assembly source code implementing cryptographic functions (GHASH, GCM multiplication, initialization) optimized for ARMv7 architecture on Apple platforms, generated from BoringSSL's Perl script.

methods.name: _gcm_init_v8
methods.description: Initializes the GHASH table with the hash subkey for ARMv7 architecture.

methods.name: _gcm_gmult_v8
methods.description: Performs Galois field multiplication for GHASH on ARMv7.

methods.name: _gcm_ghash_v8
methods.description: Computes GHASH over input data using ARMv7 SIMD instructions.
